commit_message: Add ADR 0110 portable humanoid motion baking
pr_title: Implement ADR 0110 humanoid profiles and motion
pr_body: Implements ADR 0110 in staged dispatcher requests. This stage adds skeleton-independent HumanoidMotion using model-space rotation deltas, target-profile baking back to ordinary AnimationClip, root-motion metadata without implicit proportion scaling, loss diagnostics that preserve the Native variant, and content-addressed Derived Cache integration keyed by motion, target skeleton identity, target profile, and algorithm version. Earlier stages added the model-owned profile contract and structural validation/detection. Follow-up stages wire imported Humanoid variants, Animation Set Auto/Native/Humanoid source selection, editor configuration, target resolution, and packaging.
